description: *Available Immediately** **Unfurnished** Stunning, fully renovated four bed, two bath house, extending to approx. 117 sqm, in a beautiful and quiet part of Stillorgan. Accommodation consists of; entrance hall way, living room to the front with stove, newly fitted kitchen to rear, utility, large double bedroom with jack and jill shower room and a large garden. Upstairs you find three generous bedrooms with storage, and a high end family bathroom. Just a few minutes walk from Stillorgan Shopping center and the N11, this really is a prime location.
